title: John Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on John 7: the Feast of Booths, the teaching in the temple, the division in the crowd and the words of Nicodemus.

questions.text: Which feast of the Jews was at hand?
questions.explanation: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

answers.text: The Passover
The feast of unleavened bread
The feast of dedication
The Feast of Booths

questions.text: What does the text say about his brothers, who told him to go into Judea?
questions.explanation: His brothers told him to depart and go into Judea so that his disciples might see his works, for even his brothers didn't believe in him.

answers.text: They had followed him from the beginning
Even his brothers didn't believe in him
They were among the twelve
They were afraid of the Jews in Galilee

questions.text: How did Jesus go up to the feast after his brothers had gone?
questions.explanation: When his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

answers.text: With a great crowd around him
Riding ahead of his brothers
Not publicly, but as it were in secret
Only after the feast had ended

questions.text: What were the multitudes saying about him?
questions.explanation: There was much murmuring among the multitudes: some said, "He is a good man," and others said, "Not so, but he leads the multitude astray."

answers.text: Some said he was a good man, others that he led the multitude astray
All of them said that he was truly a prophet
All of them openly called him the Christ of God
None of them had ever heard of him before

questions.text: What did the Jews marvel at when he taught in the temple?
questions.explanation: The Jews marveled, saying, "How does this man know letters, having never been educated?"

answers.text: That he taught in the middle of the feast
That no officer dared to arrest him
That he had come up from Galilee alone
That he knew letters, having never been educated

questions.text: What did Jesus say about his teaching?
questions.explanation: He answered, "My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me."

answers.text: "My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me"
"My teaching is from Moses and the fathers"
"My teaching is only for those who believe"
"My teaching cannot be understood by anyone"

questions.text: What work did Jesus say he had done on the Sabbath?
questions.explanation: He asked why they were angry with him because he made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath, while they themselves circumcise a boy on the Sabbath.

answers.text: He circumcised a boy
He made a man completely healthy
He taught in the temple
He gave the law to the people

questions.text: What did Jesus cry out on the last and greatest day of the feast?
questions.explanation: He stood and cried out, "If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!"

answers.text: "I am the bread of life that came down"
"Search the Scriptures and see for yourselves"
"If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!"
"The feast is ended, go to your homes"

questions.text: What did the officers answer when asked why they had not brought him?
questions.explanation: The officers answered, "No man ever spoke like this man!"

answers.text: "No man ever spoke like this man!"
"The multitude would not let us near him"
"He had already left the temple"
"We are also led astray by him"

questions.text: Who reminded them that their law does not judge a man before hearing from him?
questions.explanation: Nicodemus, he who came to him by night and was one of them, asked whether their law judges a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does.

answers.text: One of the chief priests
One of the officers
A ruler from Galilee
Nicodemus
